sloka: निवर्तिते अपि च बलात् सुहृद् वर्गे च राजिनि ।न एव ते सम्न्यवर्तन्त रामस्य अनुगता रथम् ॥२-४५-२॥
transliteration: nivartite api ca balāt suhṛd varge ca rājini ।na eva te samnyavartanta rāmasya anugatā ratham ॥2-45-2॥

translations.english: The king and the hosts of friends were forcibly sent back but they did not return. They continued to follow the chariot of Rama.
